title: Legacy keystore-go accepts JKS truststores with missing integrity digests
summary: Legacy keystore-go Decode accepts a JKS file with its trailing integrity digest removed. A writer can replace trusted CA certificates without the keystore password; certificate-only stores also lose password verification.

severity.rationale: Replacing trusted certificates can compromise TLS trust. Exploitation requires write access to the keystore or deployment artifact, so this is a conditional integrity failure.

affected.note: Every legacy bare-module release through v2.1.0+incompatible is affected. No fixed release exists on that module path; v3 and v4 are not affected.

exposure: Applications relying on Decode to detect changes to JKS truststores are exposed when attackers can modify the input.

params.instructions: Check Go module dependencies for the legacy github.com/pavel-v-chernykh/keystore-go path. Every release there is affected; migration to an unaffected successor module is required.

remediation.details: Migrate legacy imports to github.com/pavlo-v-chernykh/keystore-go/v4; the advisory identifies v3 and v4 as unaffected.
remediation.risk: Medium. A major-version and import-path migration needs compatibility testing.

verification: Confirm legacy imports are gone and a disposable truncated truststore is rejected.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record from directly inspected primary evidence; independent review pending.
